# The package embeds templates with other extensions than .gohtml. An
# embedded .html, .htm, .tmpl or .gotmpl file is read for its links and
# <style> elements like a .gohtml one: here the layout, layout.html, links
# style.css, which makes .code preserve whitespace, so the partial's .code
# interior is left as written.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt fmt -w partial.gohtml
cmp partial.gohtml want.gohtml

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml *.html
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml", "*.html"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- assets/style.css --
.code{white-space:pre}
-- layout.html --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css">{{template "partial"}}{{end}}
-- partial.gohtml --
{{define "partial"}}<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>x</p>
</section>{{end}}
-- want.gohtml --
{{define "partial"}}
	<section>
		<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
		<p>x</p>
	</section>
{{end}}
